title: What's New at AT&T Stadium in Arlington, Texas for 2025? - NewsBreak
text:
By Stryker ,
6 hours ago Getty Images The Dallas Cowboys home opener is this Sunday and the team has announced some new upgrades to the stadium that fans can enjoy this year.
Sadly, my Dallas Cowboys are 0-1 to start the season, but they have a winning streak against their opponent on Sunday. The Cowboys have won eight straight against the New York Giants dating back to 2021 and this game on Sunday is the 1,000th game in Dallas Cowboys history. Fans going to the game can check out the following features.
Kendra Scott Lounge (Located on North Side Silver Level) Getty Images for Kendra Scott For the jewelry lover in your life, fashion designer Kendra Scott has her own lounge in AT&T Stadium . They will have the America’s team line for sale exclusively here in the stadium. This jewelry is the same one’s worn by the Dallas Cowboys cheerleaders.
Sensory Rooms (Section 417,447, C208, and C237) Getty Images Altec Lansing who makes speakers and headphones have designed four different sensory rooms at AT&T Stadium. If the game is overwhelming to someone in your family, they can go here to hang out instead. They will have sensory supplies and noise cancelling headphones.
Nursing Rooms (Section 417,447,C208, and C237) Getty Images Nuna, who makes baby accessories has built private nursing rooms for moms to feed their young children. Let’s be honest, not a lot of privacy during a football game, but you can go to these air conditioned rooms during a game to feed your child in peace. They will also have baby changing tables if you need to use those as well.
FREE Charging Stations (Near Entries D and J/ Plus Behind Sections 408 & 439) Getty Images Free and the Dallas Cowboys usually don’t go together. If your phone has a habit of dying during a game. You can use one of the many Reliant Energy charging stations. No more having to awkwardly bring your charger in your pocket and find an outlet.
RFID Wristbands for Quicker Entry Getty Images If you have a club or suite tickets, you will be given a wristband this year to help with quicker entry into the club section. Less lines always a good move.
Drinks Can Now Be Sold in Yeti Tumbler Getty Images The Dallas Cowboys Yeti Tumbler will be sold at the majority of bars and concession stands this season. So if you want to ensure that drink is staying cold, Jerry Jones is ready to upsell you on a new cup.
New Drink, Cowboys Michelada These drinks will be available at the majority of bars and Miller Lite Stands in the stadium. Miller Lite and Clamato have teamed up to bring these throughout AT&T Stadium.
New Art Installations (Entries E and K) Getty Images For those will special access to Entries E and K. Typically for suite access. New art installations have been installed. You can actually check out some of the art here .
Gameday Tours Getty Images Throughout the week, you can take a tour of AT&T Stadium. The Dallas Cowboys are now doing them as well on game day. You get all the same access, except you will be on the field during team warmups. For the super fan, this will be a cool experience to see with a full stadium.
Faster Custom Jerseys in the Pro Shop Getty Images The Cowboys have teamed up with Emblex that will get you a faster custom jersey on game day. They say your one of a kind jersey can be made in the main pro shop with whatever name or number you want.
Dallas Cowboys App Updated Getty Images The Cowboys have updated their app for faster service. Whether that be getting food or drinks getting delivered directly to your seat. Plus better maps to find out everything AT&T Stadium has to offer. Season ticket holders have easier access to their discount in the Pro Shop for the app. Finally club level guests can scan QR codes throughout the stadium to view iconic moments in Dallas Cowboys history.
The majority of these additions are for families attending AT&T Stadium this season. As long as the Dallas Cowboys are winning games, that’s all I care about. I’ll be there Sunday cheering on the Boys.
